market.question: Will US crude oil reserves fall to 275M by June 5?

assessment.reasoning: SPR was ~409M barrels as of week ending Apr 10, 2026. Reaching 275M by June 5 (about 8 weekly reports) would require ~17M barrel/week drawdown, far exceeding any historical pace. SPR has been refilling, not drawing down. Historic minimum ~346M (mid-2023). Effectively impossible barring an unprecedented emergency release.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Only an enormous unannounced emergency release would change this.
